description: This file defines the 'List' feature for comments within a .NET application using MediatR for CQRS pattern. It includes a query class and a handler to retrieve comments for a specific article identified by its slug.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: A request object implementing IRequest to fetch comments for an article identified by slug.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the Query to retrieve comments. Uses Entity Framework Core to fetch article comments including authors, throws if article is not found, and returns a CommentsEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the Query, fetches the article with comments from the database, throws a RestException if not found, and returns the comments inside a CommentsEnvelope.
